steps.title: Dark adapt plants
steps.instruction: Dark adapt plants for at least 20 minutes (ideally overnight) before any measurements to fully oxidize the photosynthetic electron transport chain and open reaction centres.

substeps.instruction: A properly adapted healthy plant should show an Fv/Fm value of ~0.8; values below ~0.7 indicate incomplete adaptation or stress.

steps.title: Prepare extra focus plate
steps.instruction: Prepare an extra plate containing a few leaf disks or additional plant material that will be used solely for focus adjustment.

steps.title: Place plate and set focus
steps.instruction: Place the extra plate inside the imaging chamber, adjust the focus dial above the chamber, and lock the focus position by turning the side screw.

steps.title: Position leaf in chamber
steps.instruction: Position the leaf (or plant) so that its surface is 140 mm from the base of the imaging chamber; adjust by raising or lowering the specimen as needed.

steps.title: Adjust aperture and map image
steps.instruction: Manually adjust the aperture to allow an optimal amount of light without over‑exposing the measurement, then adjust focus, press the "map image" button, and finally change the plate/plant to the one you intend to read.

substeps.instruction: If "map image" is not pressed, the light will continue flashing when the chamber is opened.

steps.title: Apply isolation background
steps.instruction: Apply the isolation‑background function to isolate the plant or leaf of interest; repeat the operation if background remains, noting that masked areas appear blue.

steps.title: Load and configure protocol
steps.instruction: Load the desired measurement protocol; if changes are required, open Settings > Protocol and adjust parameters using the left‑hand menu.

steps.title: Start fluorescence measurement
steps.instruction: When the scheduled program is set as desired, click the protocol icon in the toolbar to start the run.

steps.title: Export images and data
steps.instruction: After the reading is complete, save the images via File > Save As, then export the image files for processing via File > Export to Folder (saved in the currently opened folder).
